# Homestead, Farming & Animal Husbandry Requirements Quality Checklist

**Purpose**: Đánh giá chất lượng, độ rõ ràng, tính nhất quán và độ phủ bảo mật của bộ yêu cầu sinh tồn, nông trại, chăn nuôi và xây dựng lãnh địa (`008-housing-farming`).
**Created**: 2026-11-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Survival & World Clock Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK001 Are all five `Hunger` threshold bands (`WELL_FED` through `EXHAUSTED`), offline hunger freeze behavior, and the non-lethal `Hunger = 0` rule explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the `2`-slot Food Buff limit (`FOOD_COMBAT` and `FOOD_UTILITY`), same-channel override rule, and consumption cooldown unambiguously defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the world clock durations (`24` real minutes/day, `14` in-game days/season) and 24-hour weather history persistence requirements quantified consistently? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002]

## Farming & Offline Simulation Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK004 Are all 15 crops (`5` MVP), 6 farming actions, growth stage transitions, unwatered pause behavior (`PAUSED_UNTIL_WATERED`), seasonal withering, and Lv 4 greenhouse off-season mitigation completely specified against `game-data/crops.json`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK005 Are crop quality tiers (`NORMAL`/`SILVER`/`GOLD`), fertilizer modifiers (`csm_fertilizer_basic`, `csm_fertilizer_rich`), and regrow behaviors clearly defined without conflicting formulas? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the 100% server-timestamp offline catch-up rule, its strict `24-hour` cap, and complete rejection of client clocks unambiguously specified for crops, animals, and construction timers? [Security, Spec §FR-005, Spec §SC-001, Constitution §II]

## Animal Husbandry Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK007 Are all 6 animal species (`2` MVP including `anm_clover_cow` starter pasture on `bld_farm_plot` Lv 2 and free reassignment to `bld_barn`) and their building capacity requirements completely specified? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the non-lethal starvation rule (`permanentDeathAllowed = false`, minimum `health = 20`), happiness-driven quality scaling, and anti-exploit guards (no feeding at `hunger >= 90`, 1 petting reward per in-game day) explicitly specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Homestead Building Placement & Permissions Quality

- [ ] CHK009 Are all 13 buildings (`6` MVP including `bld_blacksmith` Lv 1..4 enhancement gates `+3/+6/+8/+10`) tied directly to `game-data/buildings.json` with per-level visual variants? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK010 Are all 7 server-side placement validation layers — including `32x32 px` grid snapping, rotation bounds, forbidden corridor/spawn/quest masks, footprint overlap, and BFS reachability to every `interactionPoints` tile — explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK011 Are building lifecycle rules (sequential upgrades, `80%` cancel refund, `50%` empty-only demolish refund, and immutable protection of `bld_player_house`) free of ambiguity or exploit loops? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Are `OWNER_ONLY` vs `PARTY_ACCESS` boundaries explicitly enumerated so party helpers can water/pet/feed/feast while being strictly barred from harvesting, collecting produce, opening storage, or altering buildings? [Security, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-009]

## Persistence, Edge Cases & Performance Honesty

- [ ] CHK013 Do all persistence requirements consistently mandate local JSON files (`houses/<characterId>.json`, `world/world-clock.json`) and JSON WAL atomic transactions with zero external DBMS or third-party services? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-008, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK014 Are full-inventory/storage edge cases, concurrent buy/place race protections, entity-occupied move handling, and `proposed / unverified` performance targets explicitly documented? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §SC-005, Constitution §VIII]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after human/lead review confirms each requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
